TextView.android:text: Read first: set up car model and permissions
On first install, grant all required permissions
Choose car model to match camera layout
Maximum recording length of each video segment
Set video resolution and recording bitrate
Zoom/pan correction for the main preview
Fisheye correction for the preview, does not affect recording
Doesn\'t affect photos or DingTalk commands
Choose where videos and photos are stored
Write to internal storage first, then move to USB drive to avoid stutter (recommended)
Auto-delete oldest files when over the limit (blank or 0 = no limit)
Deletes an extra 20 percent, e.g. a 10 GB limit deletes down to 8 GB
Show recording time and segment count top right (double-tap to toggle)
Add a timestamp watermark to the top left of saved videos/images; video watermark only works in MediaCodec mode (slight performance impact)
When on, uses H.264 compatible path (MediaCodec mode only) to fix flicker or recording failures on some head units under H.265; off by default, using H.265/HEVC for better compression
EVCam starts by itself when the car\'s screen starts up
Start recording when EVCam starts and keep recording in the background while you use other apps
When on, keeps recording with screen off; when off, stops 10 s after screen off and resumes 10 s after screen on

While the car is parked and left, keep recording (to the USB stick when one is plugged in) and save a picture from each outside camera into the Sentry folder every few minutes. Oldest sentry pictures are deleted first when the drive gets full. Works only while the car keeps the screen unit on.
Wakes every 15 min to keep the process alive
Stop deep sleep so messages arrive with ignition off (uses more power)
Show floating record button, tap to open app
Show a record button in the background; tap to start/stop and show time
Above the speed threshold, press the custom key to open/close EVCam preview (Dragon Eagle One models only)

• Permissions: manage the permissions the app needs

• Car model: choose your car model to match its camera layout

• Recording mode:
 - Auto: picks the best option for your car model
 - MediaRecorder: system hardware encoding
 - MediaCodec: software encoding

• Segment length: maximum length of each video segment
 - 1 min: small files, easy to share
 - 3 min: balances file size and continuity
 - 5 min: fewer files

• Storage location:
 - Internal storage: /DCIM/EVCam_Video/
 - USB drive: USB drive/DCIM/ (needs permission)
 - Choosing USB drive enables staged writing
 (writes to internal storage first, then moves each segment to the USB drive)

• Storage auto-cleanup:
 - Set separate storage limits for videos and images
 - Checked 30 s after cold start and every hour
 - Oldest files are deleted when over the limit (blank or 0 = no limit)

• Recording status display:
 - Shows time and segment count at top right while recording
 - Double-tap to show/hide quickly

• Timestamp overlay:
 - Adds a time watermark to the top left of saved videos/images
 - Only affects saved files, not the preview
 - Video timestamp only works in MediaCodec mode

• Start when the car starts: EVCam starts by itself after the screen starts up

• Record automatically:
 - Starts recording when EVCam starts
 - Resumes recording when returning from background
 - Uses a foreground service so recording isn't interrupted

• Screen-off recording (locked car recording):
 - Only available when Record automatically is on
 - On: keeps recording when the screen is off (car locked)
 - Off: stops recording 10 s after screen off
 - Resumes recording 10 s after screen on

• Scheduled keep-alive: wakes every 15 min to stay active

• Prevent sleep: blocks deep system sleep
 - When on, remote messages work with the car off
 - Uses more 12V battery power, enable only if needed

• Floating window: shows a floating record button
